title: Ukrainian Chicken Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish from Ukraine, made with tender chicken and fresh vegetables. Serve hot with some crusty bread.
instructions: Season the chicken with zesty seasoning. In a large skillet, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add another tablespoon of oil if necessary. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the velvety sour cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
